description: Dependency updates of the base images (D3 §6.3, D10 §6.10 in github-demo). Every tool pin is a Dockerfile ARG under a `# renovate:` hint; the upstream Temurin images are the ARG TEMURIN_IMAGE of each Dockerfile; the workflow actions are pinned by major. No release line here: a merge publishes new dated image tags.

packageRules.description: Workflow actions (majors pinned) are CI-only changes.
kind and kubectl track the kind release's default node image; bump them together.
The Docker CLI and its compose and buildx plugins come from one apt repository; bump them together.

customManagers.description: Tool pins in the Dockerfiles: a `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` hint names the datasource and package of the `ARG <KEY>=<value>` line below it (docs/toolchains.md).
